trades.audit:
GRADE_MaxWeese25: B+
GRADE_Mr texas: B
WINNER: MaxWeese25
ANALYSIS:
Cam Ward is a 24‑year‑old quarterback with one completed season for TEN, offering potential upside at a young age. A 2027 third‑round pick represents a future prospect but carries less immediate impact than a player already on an NFL roster. Consequently, MaxWeese25 received the higher‑value asset.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: B+
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: C
WINNER: Dayton Degenerates
ANALYSIS:
Dayton receives WR Jahan Dotson (age 26, 4 completed seasons) plus a 2027 2nd‑round and a 2029 3rd‑round pick. Syracuse receives TE Travis Kelce (age 37, 13 completed seasons) and a 2029 2nd‑round pick. The younger player and the earlier 2027 pick give Dayton greater dynasty value.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: B
GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C+
WINNER: Fire Haslam Into The Sun
ANALYSIS:
Stefon Diggs is a 32‑year‑old, 11‑season wide receiver from Washington, providing immediate, proven production but limited future upside. The 2028 second‑round pick is a two‑year‑away asset with uncertain value and no guarantee of impact. The veteran WR outweighs the speculative future pick, giving Fire Haslam Into The Sun the better side of the trade.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: A-
GRADE_noahsaint: B+
WINNER: Dayton Degenerates
ANALYSIS:
Jonathon Brooks is a 23‑year‑old RB for Carolina with two completed seasons, offering youthful upside in a dynasty context. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is a 27‑year‑old RB for Jacksonville with three completed seasons, providing more proven production but limited upside. Consequently, Dayton receives the higher‑upside asset, giving them the better side of the trade.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: C+
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: B+
WINNER: Worthy of my Chuba
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup acquired veteran QB Patrick Mahomes (KC, 31, 9 seasons) and RB Chuba Hubbard (CAR, 27, 5 seasons) plus a 2028 first‑round pick. Worthy of my Chuba received a younger QB Anthony Richardson Sr. (IND, 24, 3 seasons) and two 2027 first‑round picks plus a 2028 third‑round pick. The combination of multiple near‑term first‑round assets and a younger quarterback outweighs the immediate star value of Mahomes and Hubbard, giving Worthy the superior dynasty return.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: A-
GRADE_Chicken Soup: B
WINNER: Fire Haslam Into The Sun
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam received quarterback Joe Burrow, a 29‑year‑old with six completed seasons, along with third‑round picks in 2027 and 2029. Chicken Soup received tight end Brock Bowers, a 23‑year‑old with two completed seasons. The combination of an established quarterback and two future mid‑round selections outweighs the value of a young tight end, giving Fire Haslam the superior return.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: B-
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: A-
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Bryce Young (QB, CAR, 25, 3 seasons) and a 2028 third‑round pick go to MaxWeese25, while Sam Darnold (QB, SEA, 29, 8 seasons) and a 2028 first‑round pick go to Syracuse Sandstorms. The younger quarterback offers longer potential upside, but the first‑round pick provides a higher guaranteed future asset, giving Syracuse a net advantage in dynasty value.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: B+
GRADE_spearson22: A-
WINNER: spearson22
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup received a 2029 first‑round pick, which will be three seasons away and therefore holds less immediate dynasty value. spearson22 obtained a 2028 first‑round pick, only two seasons away, making it a higher‑valued asset. The earlier pick gives spearson22 the advantage in this trade.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Dayton received TE AJ Barner (age 24, 2 completed seasons) and TE T.J. Hockenson (age 29, 7 completed seasons) plus a 2029 4th‑round pick. Justin received a 2027 3rd‑round pick, a 2028 4th‑round pick and a 2029 4th‑round pick. The three mid‑round future picks give Justin more flexible, long‑term upside than the two tight ends Dayton acquired.

GRADE_T-Mac Attack: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Jordan Mason is a 27‑year‑old RB with four completed seasons and provides limited immediate upside, while the 2027 4th‑round pick is a modest future asset. Justin Jefferfather receives a 2027 3rd‑round and a 4th‑round pick, which together represent higher draft capital than the player‑plus‑4th combination. Therefore the trade favors Justin Jefferfather.

GRADE_noahsaint: B+
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: C+
WINNER: noahsaint
ANALYSIS:
Noahsaint acquired WR Josh Downs, a 25‑year‑old player with three completed seasons for the Kansas City Chiefs. Justin Jefferfather received a 2027 second‑round draft pick, a future asset that will not be available until the following year. The known production and immediate roster impact of Downs outweigh the speculative value of a single future second‑rounder, giving Noahsaint the better side of the trade.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B+
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
Dayton Degenerates receive two 2027 second‑round selections, which are future mid‑round assets roughly one year away from the draft. All Gas No Bench acquires D'Andre Swift, a 27‑year‑old RB with six completed seasons for Chicago, providing immediate proven production. The veteran RB offers substantially higher current dynasty value than two future second‑round picks, giving All Gas the advantage.

GRADE_All Gas No Bench: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+

ANALYSIS:
Emanuel Wilson is a 27‑year‑old RB with three completed seasons for Seattle, offering limited upside at this stage of his career. A 2028 third‑round pick represents a two‑year‑away asset with potential to develop into a valuable roster piece. Consequently, the future pick provides greater dynasty value than the veteran RB, giving Justin Jefferfather the advantage.

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather

Justin received RB De'Von Achane (MIA, 25, 3 seasons) and a 2027 first‑round and second‑round pick. MaxWeese25 received Tre Tucker. Justin Jefferfather received 2028 Round 3, 2028 Round 4. On the assets exchanged, MaxWeese25 comes out ahead.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C+
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: B+

GRADE_MaxWeese25: C+
GRADE_Mr texas: B+
WINNER: Mr texas
ANALYSIS:

Mr texas receives TE Hunter Henry (NE, 31, 10 seasons), RB David Montgomery (HOU, 29, 7 seasons), WR Michael Pittman Jr. (PIT, 29, 6 seasons) along with a 2027 first‑round and a 2026 third‑round pick, adding proven players and additional draft capital. The trio of established veterans plus two picks outweighs the two early 2026 picks, giving Mr texas the superior side of the trade.

GRADE_Mr texas: C+
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: A-

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: A-
GRADE_spearson22: B
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:

Spearson received Courtland Sutton, a 31‑year‑old WR with eight completed seasons, and Rico Dowdle, a 28‑year‑old RB with six completed seasons, both of which are aging veterans with limited upside. The combination of a near‑term first‑rounder and a later second‑rounder outweighs the veteran package, giving Syracuse the superior dynasty return.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: C
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B

ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam Into The Sun acquired RB De'Von Achane (MIA, 25, 3 seasons) and a 2027 third‑round pick. All Gas No Bench received WR DeVonta Smith (PHI, 28, 5 seasons) and a 2027 second‑round pick. The second‑rounder and the older, proven WR provide more immediate and long‑term dynasty value than the younger RB and a later pick.
